question: If Kwon is assigned to be leader for exactly one of the committees, then for which of the committees is the assignment of volunteers to positions fully determined?

# Declarations
volunteers = EnumSort([Haddad, Joslin, Kwon, Molina, Nash])
committees = EnumSort([X, Y, Z])
positions = EnumSort([leader, secretary, treasurer])
assigned = Function([volunteers, committees] -> [bool])
holds_position = Function([volunteers, committees, positions] -> [bool])

# Constraints
ForAll([c:committees], Count([v:volunteers], assigned(v, c)) == 3) ::: Each committee will have three volunteers assigned to it
ForAll([v:volunteers, c:committees], Count([p:positions], holds_position(v, c, p)) <= 1) ::: each volunteer on a committee holding exactly one of three positions
ForAll([c:committees, p:positions], Count([v:volunteers], holds_position(v, c, p)) == 1) ::: each committee has exactly one volunteer for each position
ForAll([v:volunteers, c:committees, p:positions], Implies(holds_position(v, c, p), assigned(v, c))) ::: If a volunteer holds a position on a committee, they are assigned to that committee
ForAll([c:committees], Implies(assigned(Nash, c), holds_position(Nash, c, leader))) ::: If Nash is assigned to a committee, Nash must be the leader for that committee
Count([c:committees], assigned(Molina, c)) == 1 ::: Molina must be assigned to exactly one committee
assigned(Kwon, Y) ::: Kwon must be assigned to Y
Not(assigned(Kwon, Z)) ::: but cannot be assigned to Z
holds_position(Joslin, Y, secretary) ::: Joslin must be the secretary for Y
Not(assigned(Joslin, X)) ::: but cannot be assigned to X
Not(assigned(Joslin, Z)) ::: or Z
Count([c:committees], holds_position(Kwon, c, leader)) == 1 ::: If Kwon is assigned to be leader for exactly one of the committees
